name: context-guard
description: Lets Claude check how full its context is, warns it past a share of the autocompact window, lets it compact the session at a stopping point and carry on, and counts the compactions, stopping Claude past a number of them without you.

warnPercent.title: Warn at %
warnPercent.description: How full the window is, in percent, when Claude and you are first told: autocompact's window where autocompact is on, else the model's whole window. 80 by default.

compactionLimit.title: Compactions without you
compactionLimit.description: How many compactions Claude carries on through before you write again: past it Claude is told to stop, and past one more its tool calls are refused until you write. 3 by default; 0 stops Claude at the first.
